meals.name: Spaghetti bolognese
steps: Fry chopped onion, garlic and grated carrot in the oil for 5 min. Add the mince and brown it.
Add the tomatoes, salt and pepper. Simmer 20–25 min.
Boil the pasta in well-salted water and toss with the sauce.

meals.name: Frikadeller with potatoes & red cabbage
steps: Mix the mince with grated onion, egg, milk, oats, 1 tsp salt and pepper. Rest 15 min.
Boil the potatoes in salted water.
Shape with a wet spoon and fry in the oil on medium heat, about 6 min per side.
Serve with the potatoes and warm red cabbage.

meals.name: Hakkebøf with soft onions
meals.dk: Hakkebøf med bløde løg, brun sauce & kartofler
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water.
Slice the onions and cook them slowly in half the butter for 15 min until soft and golden.
Shape the mince into 4 patties, season with salt and pepper and fry in the rest of the butter, 4 min per side.
Warm the brown sauce in the pan and serve with onions and potatoes.

meals.name: Lazy cabbage-roll stew
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water.
Brown the mince with the chopped onion in the oil in a large pot.
Add the shredded cabbage and stir until it collapses, about 5 min.
Add the tomatoes and 2 dl water. Simmer 20 min, season with salt and pepper, and serve with the potatoes.

meals.name: Roast chicken legs with root veg
meals.dk: Kyllingelår i ovn med kartofler & gulerødder
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss potatoes, carrots and onion wedges with oil and salt in a roasting tin.
Lay the chicken legs on top, skin up, and season with salt and pepper.
Roast 45 min until the skin is crisp and the juices run clear.

meals.name: Medister with creamed cabbage
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water. Fry the medister in a little of the butter on medium heat for 20–25 min, turning.
Boil the shredded cabbage in salted water for 5 min and drain well.
Simmer the rest of the butter with the cream for 3 min, fold in the cabbage and season with salt and pepper.

meals.name: Pork tenderloin in mushroom cream
steps: Slice the tenderloin into medallions, season with salt and pepper and brown in the oil. Take them out.
Fry the onion and mushrooms in the same pan with the paprika, add the cream and simmer 3 min.
Return the meat and simmer 8–10 min.
Boil the rice in salted water and serve together.

meals.name: Bacon & broccoli pasta
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water, adding the vegetables for the last 3 min.
Fry the bacon crisp. Whisk the eggs with the grated cheese and plenty of pepper.
Off the heat, toss the drained pasta with the bacon, then the egg mix and a splash of pasta water until glossy.

meals.name: Sausage & potato stew
steps: Brown the sliced sausages and onion in the oil.
Add diced potatoes, pepper, tomatoes, paprika and 3 dl water.
Simmer 25 min until the potatoes are tender, and season with salt.

meals.name: Sausage pasta in tomato sauce
steps: Fry the chopped onion, garlic and sliced sausages in the oil for 5 min.
Add the tomatoes and paprika and simmer 10 min. Season with salt.
Boil the pasta in salted water and toss with the sauce.

meals.name: Pan-fried fish with rice & greens
steps: Boil the rice in salted water.
Season the fish with salt and pepper and fry in most of the oil, 3–4 min per side.
Stir-fry the vegetables in the rest of the oil with the soy sauce and serve together.

meals.name: Chickpea & tomato curry
steps: Fry the onion in the oil, add the karry and garlic for 1 min.
Add the drained chickpeas, tomatoes, coconut milk and vegetables. Simmer 15 min and season with salt.
Boil the rice in salted water and serve together.

meals.name: Potato & pepper frittata
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 12 min, then slice.
Fry the potatoes, onion and pepper in the oil in an ovenproof pan.
Pour over the eggs beaten with salt and pepper. Cook on low heat 8 min.
Top with the cheese and finish under the oven grill until set.

meals.name: Porridge with apple
steps: Simmer the oats in the milk with a pinch of salt for 5 min, stirring.
Top with the chopped fruit.

meals.name: Bread roll with cheese
steps: Halve and toast the roll, butter thinly.
Add the cheese and sliced vegetables.

meals.name: Overnight oats
steps: Stir the oats, skyr and milk together in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight and top with fruit.

meals.name: Yoghurt with muesli
steps: Bowl, yoghurt, muesli, fruit.

meals.name: Egg & cheese toast
steps: Fry the egg in the butter with a pinch of salt.
Toast the bread with the cheese on top until melted, and put the egg on top.

meals.name: Rye bread with leverpostej
steps: Spread the leverpostej on two slices of rye.
Top with sliced cucumber.

meals.name: Sausage & vegetable soup
steps: Fry the sliced sausage and leek in the oil.
Add diced potatoes and carrots, the tomatoes and 1 l water.
Simmer 25 min and season with salt and pepper. Keeps 4 days.

meals.name: Rye bread with cheese & veg
steps: Butter two slices of rye and add the cheese and vegetables.
